result:
Lint is clean and the full test suite passes (1584 passed).

## Summary

The prior fix (#3482) added a `_SkipClose` wrapper used only by `_nullpager`, but `_pipepager`/`_tempfilepager` fall back to the caller's raw stdout too (when `PAGER` points at a missing binary, or no pager is installed). In that path, `get_pager_file` wraps the real stdout buffer directly in `MaybeStripAnsi` (a `TextIOWrapper`). When that wrapper is garbage-collected, `TextIOWrapper`'s default `__del__` calls `close()`, which closes the underlying buffer — silently closing the caller's real stdout out from under them (the actual root cause of #3449, reproducible by checking `.closed` on the borrowed stream after the pager block exits and GC runs).

Fix: gave `MaybeStripAnsi` the same `__del__` pattern already used by `_NonClosingTextIOWrapper` in `_compat.py` — `detach()` instead of `close()`, swallowing errors — so garbage collection never closes a stream it doesn't own. Verified with a manual repro that `.closed` stayed `False` before the fix and `True` after (confirming the bug), then flipped once the fix was applied. Added regression assertions to the two existing fallback tests in `tests/test_termui.py`, and a `CHANGES.rst` entry.
